fee_notes: Three packages: Single=$49,000, Multi-2=$88,000, Multi-3=$125,000. Active-duty/veteran 10% discount on first franchise yields floor of $44,100. In fiscal year ending Dec 31, 2025, collected IFFs ranging $44,100-$49,000 reflecting that discount. Additional required fees: Launch Fee ($30,000 for 1st location), Pre-Opening Marketing Package ($15,000), Annual Reunion Fee ($1,500), Microsite/Social Media Setup ($300). Multi-2/3 franchisees do not pay additional IFF for units 2-3; royalty capped at 6% for those units.
